Hello everyone, welcome to this virtual Alganan Islam Conference, organized by Tennis Australia, and thanks for the federation, and mainly to Martín Roca, for inviting me to prepare this presentation. I am David Sanz from Spain, and I have been involved in the Spanish Tennis Association for more than 15 years as Director of Coaches Education and Research Department, and nowadays I am working in one online university, place in Malaga, Spain, the name of this university is Udamed, and you can see the picture in the slide, and also I am collaborating as advisor of tennis coaches, players, and some entities as federation, academies, and tennis clubs. In this presentation I will deal about learning process, and specifically about constrained late approach applied to tennis training, from the theory to the practice, from my experience on tennis coach. And as you can see the index of my presentation will mix some theoretical aspect about the methodological models, about the constrained late approach, and finally I will explain practical proposal with some drills that could be useful for tennis coaches in order to apply this proposal.
